name: Schesa
description: Schesa was a terrestrial planet in the Unknown Regions, situated in the Schesa system near the edge of the Chiss Ascendancy. It was a major Chiss world. Pirates connected to the Lioaoin Regime attacked shipping off of Schesa and Pesfavri.
lead_paragraphs: Schesa was a terrestrial planet in the Unknown Regions, situated in the Schesa system near the edge of the Chiss Ascendancy. It was a major Chiss world. Pirates connected to the Lioaoin Regime attacked shipping off of Schesa and Pesfavri.
The Schesa triad was a communications triad located on Schesa.
